Readable at 32/48/56px. No photographic texture, tiny scratches, excessive detail or glossy specular. Match the supplied Wood icon's rendering style; don't copy its subject, wood, logs or rope unless requested.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is Wood STYLE ONLY. This item has no final model: follow description exactly. Last image is a SAME-SET equipment STYLE reference; match its finish and, for winter clothing, its slate blue and ivory palette.
SUBJECT FurHood (모피 후드): 부드러운 회갈색 후드, 아이보리 두꺼운 털 테두리, 안쪽 얼굴 부분 비움. 투구와 달리 금속 없음. (an empty gray brown fur hood with a thick ivory fur rim)
COMPOSITION: weak-perspective three-quarter view; clothing nearly front view with empty interiors and no mannequin. Long tools grip lower-left, functional end upper-right; do not mirror actual model. Food viewed slightly from above so contents read.
No text, numbers, UI slots/frames/badges, extra objects, hands, people, mannequins, backgrounds, ground, cast shadow, steam, particles, external glow or watermark. A single cohesive collectible; paired boots or specified clusters count as one item.
